extraction.name: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
extraction.description: A framework for robotic failure analysis and correction, including a dataset of 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 tasks and 53 scenes, and a model capable of task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.citeAs: Lu, W., Ye, M., Ye, Z., Tao, R., Yang, S., & Zhao, B. (2025). RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction. arXiv preprint arXiv:2505.12224v3.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data collected from simulation (ManiSkill environment with YCB objects, ReplicaCAD, AI2-THOR) and real-world (SO-100 robotic arm via teleoperation). Simulation: 14 tasks, 8,960 failure trajectories, 1,160 successful trajectories. Real-world: 6 tasks, 480 failure trajectories, 122 successful trajectories.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Simulation data from ManiSkill environment with YCB Object Dataset, ReplicaCAD, and AI2-THOR scenes. Real-world data from SO-100 robotic arm teleoperation.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Failure data generated by replacing expert policy with code snippet that generates erroneous trajectory at selected substage. Perturbations applied to end-effector pose.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning retained approximately 75% of collected data. For real-world data, videos accompanied by textual descriptions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Eight question types annotated: task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, failure locating, failure explanation, high-level correction, low-level correction. Reference answers for first five types extracted from textual descriptions; for last three types, GPT-4o generated answers with manual review and correction.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure annotation quality.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current integration of the model into VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless. Success rate remains subject to further enhancement due to VLA model's limited ability to follow complex natural language instructions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Used for robotic failure analysis and correction, and as external critic for VLA models.
